approach: Smartkin's C++ decompilation built natively on HAB3X's SDL3 platform layer, which emulates the PS2's graphics (GS, VIF, VU1) with an OpenGL renderer; the Windows port adds Windows' calling convention, the low memory emulation, three threads and the crash fixes.
help: Testing on handhelds (ROG Ally, Steam Deck)
Bug reports with the game's log
notes: Plays from start to credits, played by hand and by testers. A steady 60 fps, or 50, 120, 144 Hz and unlimited at the same game speed; up to 4x the PS2's resolution, widescreen and 21:9; keyboard, mouse and controllers with their own button prompts; a PC options screen; an optional cutscene skip and the retail bug fixes; a mods folder and PCSX2's texture packs. The SHA-1 is of the disc's executable, SLES_525.68, which the program checks, not of the disc image. Next: the GitHub issues (AMD graphics, suggestions).
